caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sewing table with a rich brown finish, rendered in detail to show wood grain patterns throughout its surfaces. The tabletop is rectangular with rounded drop-leaf extensions on both sides. The front of the table features three drawers, the central one being larger and fitted with a keyhole, while the two flanking drawers have round drawer pulls. Below the drawers, the body curves outward, forming compartments with a ribbed tambour texture on each side. The table stands on two supports shaped with curves and cutouts, resembling lyres with vertical rods. The legs are intricately carved with leaf motifs and shaped to end in curled feet. A concave stretcher connects both sets of legs at the base, matching the wood's color and grain. The drawing has a light beige background and is signed "JOHN DANA" in the bottom left corner.
title: Work Table
